obfuscation_indicators: may not be able to pass
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantitatively supported, reporting revenue, margins, earnings, leverage, impairment, and cash deployment. Key risks include cyclical construction demand, steel-price volatility, supply disruption, hurricane impacts, weaker volumes, and limited ability to pass costs through to customers. Management maintains a cautiously positive outlook, relying partly on projected industry recovery and execution of strategic initiatives.
